definition_values.ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL:
fun n W =>
  ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W) +
    (↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 3 +
          ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 5 +
        ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 7 +
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 9)
definition_values.ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualS: fun n W t => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(t + 1))

checks.name: actual_positive_series_exactL_and_real_riemannZeta_definitions
checks.detail: actualSeries is the real cast of actual weightedR at positive rational k+1; it is not an abstract supplied sequence. exactL is the real cast of actual constantTerm plus the actual rho3,5,7,9 times zetaReal. zetaReal is (riemannZeta(s:C)).re, not a redefinition of an abstract coefficient or an assumed harmonic limit.

checks.name: positive_successor_Icc_range_cast_and_endpoint_alignment
checks.detail: The explicit bijection t in Icc1T <-> k=t-1 in rangeT has inverse k+1, including T=0. Real casts commute with actual finite rational sums, powers and division. actualSeries rangeT partial sums equal exactly finiteL(n,T), not finiteL(n,T+1). Independent T=0/T=1 tests verify the first actual value is t=1 and no t=0 pole enters.

checks.name: actual_harmonic_limit_identified_with_real_complex_zeta
checks.detail: Mathlib zeta_nat_eq_tsum_of_gt_one states genuine riemannZeta at natural s>1 equals the complex p-series. Complex.ofReal_tsum, actual casts of each term and Complex.re identify its real part with the real p-series. Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow supplies actual summability; the harmonic range(T+1) limit follows by composing natural partial-sum convergence with T+1. The added t=0 term is0 for positive s.

checks.name: all_actual_fixed_shifted_tails_vanish_including_order_one
checks.detail: For every s>=1 and fixed j, the actual harmonic difference is a finite sum over k=1..j of 1/(T+k)^s. Natural casts tend to infinity, reciprocals to0, and powers preserve this limit; two finite sums over j=0..n,s=1..9 give the actual shiftedTail limit0. No decay/cancellation premise is required for this tail theorem, including s=1.

checks.name: actual_reflection_and_stronger_degree_discharge_finite_odd_inputs
checks.detail: The exact finite odd identity uses the already proved real coefficient totals: strong properness gives actual rho1=0 and properness; Even n gives actual rho2,rho4,rho6,rho8=0. Reflection.rho and FiniteSum.rho are definitionally the same actual finite sum. No cancellation input is assumed in Summation. FiniteL then tends to the actual constant plus the four actual odd rho times genuine zetaReal, with the actual tail limit0.

checks.name: simple_pole_difference_has_true_absolute_square_majorant
checks.detail: At u>0, 1/(u+j)-1/u=-j/[u(u+j)], so its norm is j/[u(u+j)]<=j/u^2, including j=0. The independently compiled general-u norm inequality proves this exact bound. A shifted 2-series multiplied by fixed j is summable; Summable.of_norm_bounded over the complete real normed space therefore proves each actual simple-pole difference summable, rather than relying on a signed or conditional cancellation heuristic.

checks.name: actual_simple_cancellation_and_higher_pseries_build_summability
checks.detail: For each positive k+1, actual PF regularity is proved from positivity. The true rho1 zero removes the subtracted common 1/(k+1) term after the finite j sum. The remaining true simple differences are summable, and every s=2..9 shifted higher pole is a reindexed summable real p-series, multiplied by its actual coefficient. The finite j,s sum yields Summable actualSeries before any use of the finiteL limit. No Even n is needed for this summability argument.

checks.name: real_absolute_summability_and_HasSum_upgrade_are_valid
checks.detail: Summable.norm comes from the official finite-dimensional-real summable_norm_iff, applicable to E=R; therefore actualSeries is absolutely summable. Its Summable.hasSum gives convergence of all finite subsums and of natural range partial sums to the actual tsum. Uniqueness against the separately proved finiteL limit identifies that tsum with exactL, and only then transports genuine HasSum to exactL. Thus the final theorem is not inferred from natural partial-sum convergence alone, and it supplies both HasSum and tsum equality.

checks.name: independent_original_integer_quartic_X_three_and_zero_boundaries
checks.detail: Original W:Z[X],degree<=4,Even n>=2 has actual HasSum via the proved strong wrapper and natDegree_map_le, without extra zeta/rho/convergence inputs. n=0,W=X^3 is strong: actual positive series=1/(k+1)^3, true rho3=1 and other pole totals zero, exactL=(riemannZeta3).re, and genuine HasSum holds. W=0 has actual zero series and HasSum0 for every n; exactL0 in the even domain. Odd n=1 quartics still have absolute summability, separating it from the even-only odd-zeta formula.

checks.name: independent_X_four_divergence_and_totalized_tsum_boundary
checks.detail: n=0,W=X^4 is proper but not strong; its actual positive sequence is1/(k+1), not Summable and has no HasSum to any real L. Its actual finiteL tends to +infinity. Nevertheless Lean's totalized tsum is0 for a nonsummable sequence, and this excluded example also has defined exactL0; their equality is independently proved while every HasSum is false. This verifies why the genuine HasSum/absolute convergence proof and the strong domain are essential.

checks.name: actual_p9_q1_m_n_d0_infinite_identity_scope_only
checks.detail: The actual p=9,q=1,m=n,d=0 absolute summability and exact odd-zeta infinite L identity are closed in the stated domain. This is not a proof of general p, multilayer or positive derivative d cases, denominator integrality, original five-dimensional aggregate F injectivity/inverse, a prescribed integer-output inverse image and target L, J or zeta9 irrationality. No abstract coefficient array or extra convergence/zeta/cancellation hypothesis is introduced.

absolute_summability_domain: all n,W:Q[X] with 2*n+2*W.natDegree+2<=9*(n+1); no Even n premise
exact_odd_zeta_infinite_L_domain: Even n and the stronger degree bound; original n>=2,Even n,W:Z[X],degree<=4 included

  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →

    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),

findings.name: Genuine HasSum is proved after actual absolute summability
findings.detail: The true coefficient cancellation and square majorant establish Summable first; finite-dimensional real norm summability and uniqueness of the actual finiteL limit then give genuine HasSum and the exact tsum identity.

findings.name: Strong-domain boundary and totalized tsum are explicitly distinguished
findings.detail: n=0,W=X^4 is not strong and is the divergent actual harmonic series, with no HasSum to any real. Its totalized tsum still equals the defined zero exactL, demonstrating why a bare tsum equality would not certify convergence.
